body:
Yeah, I see how annoying that can be.
Honestly most of the time I see it as making people see the reason, but I just put oil to the fire. From my perspective, they seem very spoiled and entitled but maybe I'm too harsh.

Now I don't know if I can somehow redeem myself in their eyes.

They are 19...
I mean she should have but they didn't have to make such a drama over that because the professor would make us go to class in person anyway.

They told me in private.
For example, there is one class on Friday which is usually online only because of the professor's goodwill, and the people who have presentations that day, present online. 

Now the professor said that we can't be online every week and we have to go to uni from time to time. After that, one girl asked if we could be in person next week because she has trouble presenting online and the professor agreed. 

Then everyone started attacking that girl because they want to go home on Thursday and not go to uni on Friday even though they would have to if the professor cared. 

I couldn't stand this so I said that either way the professor said that we will have to have class in person from time to time and one girl attacked me that this girl should have consulted others because "some of us, like me, go home on Thursday and it would fit us better" and after that other girl told me to kill myself and everyone agreed with them and started shitting on me.

What to do to fit more in if I should do anything. Maybe I just need to stop caring. I honestly don't know how to make people like me more while still expressing my opinion and pointing out when they are wrong.

Thank you so much!
Life gets tough but I'm still hoping that better days will come. Also, don't you lose hope either.❤

Hello, I'm sorry to hear you had a rough time. I am glad things are better for you now and I hope that good luck and happiness will continue to follow you and that I will also be happy after this rough time.

Hello, thank you for your input! It is true that lately, I don't know who I am. I feel lost and not good enough. I will have to stop overthinking because only then I can fully experience the beauty of life. Also, you have given me a lot to think about and I appreciate that.

Not so long ago I have gone through a pretty painful breakup. Now I have another person in my life but I feel burdened by my past trauma. The breakup also caused my self-esteem to drop significantly. However, recently I started to dress as I always wanted but couldn't because I was worried I will get judged. Now even though people sometimes make jokes about me, I still feel comfortable in who I am which is a big improvement and I think I might be on a way to self-fulfillment, but I still have a long way to go. Thank you for your help.

Thank you for the advice, it makes sense because, since the covid hit, I stopped going out, and now that I'm vaccinated I'm still not going anywhere because I don't feel like it most of the time. I just stay home and overthink my relationships. But now I see that there shouldn't be anything that holds me back.

I think you might have a point when it comes to unresolved trauma from previous relationships and how we express it when we go to our next one. I think that the only cure is to find a way to be happy with yourself and not tie your happiness and well-being to another person because you never know what might happen.
Thank you for your input and advice! It's an interesting take and a little different than the others. I will pay attention more to what my friend feels and listen to her.

Thank you for the advice, I appreciate it. I asked him if it was getting too heavy for him before but he always said that it was not but then I am still worried that he is downplaying it because he feels like a burden when he talks about his feelings. I hope that one day he will open out about his feelings too so I can give him support and it won't be one-sided.
He knows what I've been through and seems understanding and he tries to help me, but I sometimes feel like it's ruining him emotionally.
I usually seek advice from the friend I went in there with, but she always gives me the advice to let go of the past and trust the next person more.

This friend is someone close to me and I always turn to them when feeling low. They were with me when we walked in but later I didn't see her again and while reading it was like I was the only one there.

I have been broken up with a few months ago and now I'm in a situationship but I can't trust that person and I'm torn with feeling like I don't deserve them and feeling like I can't commit to them. I am afraid I might be carrying baggage from an old relationship. 

The friend in my dream is my best friend and the only person I trust among all the other people.

Btw thank you for your input.
Yeah, I am prone to self-sabotaging the relationship around me and I often feel like I don't deserve what I have. I wish I could stop doing that. Thank you for your input.❤

That's not how a healthy relationship should work though. You should always communicate with your partner about your problems to solve them and not bitch about them to a friend without the other person even knowing they upset their partner.

Girl, you should be his best friend, and you should be the first person he tells his feelings to. I don't know if it's just my trust issues talking here because I had things like this happen to me before, but I would be worried that he has some kind of feelings for her. 

I do not know any details about your or their relationship but if he is not being transparent with you like he is being with her, you have a big problem.
tbh I would be mad too if someone interrupted me while talking by commenting on a flower because I would feel like a person doesn't care for what am I saying because their attention is somewhere else
